facts.business: Simran Farms Limited is engaged in poultry farming operations including commercial broilers, feed, medicine, vaccine, and parent bird/hatching egg production.
key_risks: Complexities and manual processes in determining inventory quantity of birds on hand and valuation of growing birds of different ages
Significant related party transactions with parties operating in the same line of business affecting both statement of profit and loss and balance sheet
facts.related_party_note: The Company and its related parties operate in the same line of business. The Company has significant transactions with the related parties which affect both the statement of profit and loss and the balance sheet. Transactions were verified to be at arm's length price and approved by Board of Directors and special resolutions as required under section 188 of Companies Act, 2013.
